title: Inventory Agreements: RX Training Library
subtitle: Video training for the RX Scan and RX Builder inventory agreement tools. Watch each course in order, then take its quiz.

courses.name: RX Scan Training
courses.summary: Impersonate a customer, view their contracts, and scan to order from an RX VMI contract.

courses.name: RX Builder Training
courses.summary: Build an inventory agreement from start to customer signature, then manage it in Modify Existing.

videos.title: Impersonating Customers
videos.description: How to select a customer and ship-to and impersonate a shopper on the site, and why to turn impersonation off when finished.

videos.title: Contracts & Scanning
videos.description: Viewing a customer's contracts (RX VMI and standard), using SCAN to order from an RX VMI contract, entering and adjusting quantities, and checking out to import a quote or order into P21.

videos.title: Entering Basic Information for a New Inventory Agreement
videos.description: Starting a new inventory agreement in RX Builder: customer and ship-to level assignment, house accounts, customer contacts, and pulling items in from a source quote.

videos.title: Entering Process, Service Schedule Information and VMI Locations
videos.description: Setting the replenishment method (Fill to Max vs Min/Max), count and delivery days, and creating named VMI locations at the ship-to.

videos.title: Placing Items in Locations and Entering Min Maxes
videos.description: Assigning items to one or more locations, setting min/max per location, and fixing max quantities flagged red for being below box, pack, or case quantity.

videos.title: Confirming Agreement & Starting PDF Signature Workflow
videos.description: Reviewing the agreement, clicking Create Contract & PDF (contract, VMI locations, pricing, and min/maxes in P21), and the customer e-signature email workflow.

videos.title: Pending Requests and Resuming from Saved Agreement
videos.description: What a pending agreement is, where saved agreements live in the Pending Requests tab, and how to resume work on one.

videos.title: Modify Existing - Alerts, Binder Contents & Labels
videos.description: Using the Modify Existing tab: approved and unapproved contracts, editing min/maxes, branch replenishment alerts, barcode label requests, signature workflow, and On-site Binder Contents PDF.
